lines.trans: Vitya, your phone is ringing.
Hi, Lyova. What did you want?
Your daughter needs help moving to a new apartment.
Did you look at the clock? I cannot right now.
Then I will ask Fedya.
Fine, all right. I will come over now.
Who called? And why are you lying?
I recognized her, that is your new cook!
They are dating. Lyova and Katya.
Love at first sight. You cannot command the heart.
Katya is even planning to move into his home.

examples.text: Лёва сейчас ремонт делает, просил помочь мебель передвинуть.
examples.trans: Lyova is doing renovations now and asked me to help move furniture.

examples.text: В квартире хороший ремонт.
examples.trans: The flat has been nicely renovated.

examples.text: Машина в ремонте.
examples.trans: The car is being repaired.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'does', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.text: Зачем жену уважаемого человека обидела, а?
examples.trans: Why did you offend the wife of an important man, huh?

examples.text: А что эта особа здесь делает?
examples.trans: And what is this person doing here?

examples.text: Пойдём, нас простили! Талантливая импровизация, видела?
examples.trans: Let's go, we are forgiven! A talented improvisation, did you see?

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'сить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'asked', paired with 'попросить'.

examples.text: Я еду туда просить для нас прощение.
examples.trans: I am heading there to ask forgiveness for us.

examples.text: Увольнение уже попросил. В этот раз я сама.
examples.trans: You already got us fired. This time I will do it myself.

examples.text: Лёва сейчас ремонт делает, просил помочь мебель передвинуть.
examples.trans: Lyova is doing renovations now and asked me to help move furniture.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'furniture' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Лёва сейчас ремонт делает, просил помочь мебель передвинуть.
examples.trans: Lyova is doing renovations now and asked me to help move furniture.

examples.text: Лёва, я вчера приезжал к тебе двигать новую мебель, которую ты купил.
examples.trans: Lyova, yesterday I came to your place to move the new furniture you bought.

examples.text: Что вы с Катей женитесь, новая жизнь, новая мебель и всё прочее.
examples.trans: That you and Katya are getting married, new life, new furniture, and all the rest.

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'двинуть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to move, shift'.

examples.text: Лёва сейчас ремонт делает, просил помочь мебель передвинуть.
examples.trans: Lyova is doing renovations now and asked me to help move furniture.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и передвинуть вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to move on time.
